fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Ijazah Sarjana Komunikasi (Master in Communication) (programme code mt14), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20241208084143): RM11,950 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/mt14, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration. Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20241208084143/https://study.uis.edu.my/mt14.

requirements.other_qualifications: Bachelor degree with minimum 2nd Class Lower
